events.label: Наука
entries: 1945 – World War II: Nagasaki is devastated when an atomic bomb, Fat Man, is dropped by the United States B-29 Bockscar. Thirty-five thousand people are killed outright, including 23,200–28,200 Japanese war workers, 2,000 Korean forced workers, and 150 Japanese soldiers.

events.label: Искусство
entries: 1942 – Dmitri Shostakovich's 7th symphony premiers in a besieged Leningrad.

events.label: Образование
entries: 1969 – Tate–LaBianca murders: Followers of Charles Manson murder pregnant actress Sharon Tate (wife of Roman Polanski), coffee heiress Abigail Folger, Polish actor Wojciech Frykowski, men's hairstylist Jay Sebring and recent high-school graduate Steven Parent.

events.label: Литература
entries: 1854 – American Transcendentalist philosopher Henry David Thoreau publishes his memoir Walden.
